axes: Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y). The train's front (the nose) is Roblox -Z.
lobbyOrigin: the lounge car's centre at floor level; 'placement' of each car is relative to it
lampNote: PointLight at every Lamp marker: Range 16, Brightness 1.2, Shadows off except the 3 dining chandeliers; the ceiling cove strips (Glow parts) carry SurfaceLights or nothing.
import: Each car is its own Model (ModelStreamingMode Persistent while the lobby is in use). Place it at lobbyCFrame * CFrame.new(placement.position). The gangway is placed 3 times.
Visual parts: Anchored, CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch off; Glass Transparency 0.55; Neon on Glow and Lamp.
Colliders: every *_Col mesh is a box. Make them invisible (Transparency 1), CanCollide on, CastShadow off, CollisionFidelity Box; or build plain Parts from 'colliders' (centre, size, yawDeg about Y).
Markers are manifest-only: create Attachments (or read the numbers) at 'markers'. Spawn_01..48 run front to back; each look is the way the player faces on arrival.

assets.name: TrainLobby_Nose
assets.notes: The lead car, seen from outside only: body like the others for 40 studs, then a bullet nose tapering over 16 studs to a dark eye with a glowing red lamp (TrainLobby_Nose_Lamp, Neon: add a red PointLight at NoseLamp). Its back door faces the lounge's closed front door.

assets.name: TrainLobby_Lounge
assets.notes: Arrival car: players join here. Club chairs in pairs with a lamp table under each wide window; a clear aisle 13 wide; the RESULTS BOARD on the left wall and the HOW TO PLAY board on the right wall face each other across the middle of the car. Front door (towards the nose) is closed; back door leads to the dining car.

ResultsBoard.note: face = the attachment's LookVector (+X Roblox, into the car); put a SurfaceGui on a 12 x 6.75 x 0.05 Part at the attachment

assets.name: TrainLobby_Dining
assets.notes: One long table (3.4 x 44, top at 2.6) laid in linen with chairs both sides; aisles of 6.1 on both sides; three chandeliers; sideboards in the corners. Doors at both ends.

assets.name: TrainLobby_Observation
assets.notes: The tail car: tall side glass over the back half, a curved bench facing the big rear window (15 x 8.2), side benches. Door at the front only.

assets.name: TrainLobby_Gangway
assets.notes: Bellows between two cars: floor, walls and roof round a 6.6 x 8.4 passage, 2.4 long. Pivot = floor top at the middle of the gap.

assets.name: TrainLobby_Scenery
assets.notes: A tileable strip of land 400 studs long (along the train), for the +X side of the train (Roblox +X); mirror a copy (rotate 180 degrees about the train's axis) for the other side. Flat layered cut-outs facing the train: Poles (x 24), Trees (x 40-70), Hills (x 110-160), HillFar (x 260), Ground. Pivot = the strip's middle, at the train's floor level; the ground is 4 below the floor. Every layer is periodic: copies at +-400 join seamlessly.
assets.pivot: strip middle at the train's floor level

scenery.speedNote: 60 studs/s (about 60 km/h at 0.28 m a stud) for the near layers; the hills slide slower to fake their distance (parallax), so the far layers do not repeat visibly. Move every layer in the train's backward direction (Roblox +Z, the cars face -Z) and wrap it by 400 when it passes 200; keep 3 copies per layer per side (-400, 0, +400) so a window never sees an end. Client only (a lobby VFX), CFrame each copy per frame or use one TweenService loop per layer.

notes: One upload per file through Open Cloud POST /assets/v1/assets (creator user 5458010221), 18 Nov 2026, approved by the owner ("Yes, upload them"). Never re-upload this file; reuse its id. A re-export needs a new upload (new id) recorded here.
No textures, no vertex colours: one flat colour per part; the importer drops colours, so set Material/Color from this manifest. Not inserted into the place (an upload check only).
